text:
alex: quick follow-up to the canary RFC — thinking about a lightweight sentinel that owns probe cadence + fallback triggers. sketched some options, want quick reactions.
jamie: love the idea. single sentinel per-cluster or per-tenant? big tradeoff there.
alex: per-tenant gives isolation but multiplies state machines. per-cluster is simpler but blast radius higher.
tanya: per-tenant but with a shared probe fleet? sentinel manages decisions, workers run probes. keeps CPU/GPU cost down.
ben: curious about ownership handoff when a sentinel bails (OOM, upgrade). need a deterministic election + lease with TTL.
hilary: agree. TTL + renewal + short backoff. when lease lost, new owner replays last state from compacted journal.
jamie: replaying state == extra complexity. can we design idempotent decisions so replay is safe? e.g., last-decision token and sequence number.
tanya: yes — decisions are append-only directives: {seq, decision, metadata}. new owner applies only seq > last_applied.
alex: proto for directive stream I sketched:
```proto
message Directive {
  uint64 seq = 1;
  string kind = 2; // "promote", "drain", "fallback", "metric-adjust"
  string target = 3; // variant id or route
  map<string,string> meta = 4;
}
```
ben: I'm worried about latency — if sentinel stalls, user traffic may sit. fallback must be local proxy-first with conservative defaults. sentinel informs policy, but proxy can decide fast.
hilary: Exactly — split control plane vs data plane. Data plane pre-loads fallback policies: e.g., "if p95 latency > 300ms OR errors > 2% => switch to fallback-variant". Sentinel just adjusts thresholds and records rollouts.
ajex: (typo) alex: +1 to preloaded policies. Also need a safe rollback marker: sticky vs ephemeral switch. sticky = until manual revert; ephemeral = auto-revert after stabilization window.
jamie: propose DSL for fallback policy, simple JSON blob:
```json
{
  "trigger": {"metric":"latency.p95","op":">","value":300},
  "action": {"type":"route","variant":"v1-fallback","sticky":false, "cooldown_s":300}
}
```
ben: Who owns the DSL? Product or runtime? if product owns, infra just enforces; but infra needs validation hooks.
tanya: runtime should provide a validator and safe defaults. product can author policies but must pass static checks (no global 100% immediate switch without canary).
hilary: need a safety gate in orchestrator: canary window, max-fraction, progression rate. e.g., start 1%, double every 10 minutes up to 50%. all encoded in rollout plan.
alex: question about telemetry. sentinel should emit compact events: probe-id, seq, decision, reason-code, metric-snapshot. avoid high-cardinality blobs.
jamie: also emit explain traces for rollbacks — easy for SRE to debug. link traces to span ids.
ben: Regarding cost: continuous probing at high QPS is expensive. recommend adaptive probing: probe-rate proportional to traffic for that variant. cold variants get sparse probes.
tanya: +1. add cache TTL for health results to reduce probe storms during global events.
hilary: operational play: during upgrades, operator can mark sentinel "quarantine-mode" where all automatic escalation is paused and only manual steps allowed. useful for risky infra changes.
alex: deployment flow idea: 1) create rollout plan + policy 2) schedule pilot 3) sentinel monitors + issues directives 4) data plane enforces fast fallback 5) telemetry + annotator for human ops.
jamie: CI check we need: static policy linter, unit tests for DSL, e2e with fake probe fleet.
ben: edge-case: split-brain leases during network partitions. solution: leases held in strongly consistent store (etcd) or optimistic with monotonic seq and tie-breaker by node-id.
tanya: can we avoid global store? use region-local sentinels + global orchestrator that only records audits. local decisions use local leader election.
hilary: that buys availability. but need global contract: eventual convergence and audit trail. good tradeoff.
alex: action items: jamie -> formalize DSL and linter; ben -> propose lease + replay semantics doc; tanya -> probe worker model + adaptive probing proposal; hilary -> policy for quarantine-mode and rollout constraints. I'll assemble a short RFC addendum with the directive proto and example DSL.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rfc-addendum/dir-proto v0.1 -> staging (started) :rocket:
jamie: cool, let's sync tomorrow 10am. ping @tanya @ben to bring examples.
ben: noted. thanks everyone.
